name: A · validators/template before-after
human_review: none new; the existing human labels (data/labels/support_review.csv) were only read, not altered or re-labelled
procedure: Template: rebuild build_template_package for every event of the bundle (fixed now=2026-10-07) with the code at each commit, count candidate/kept brief sentences and issue codes.

Cache: re-run validate_package on the 15 stored cache-mode (LLM) packages with each version; they are already post-validation outputs of the old validators, so 'before' removals are ~0 by construction and 'after' removals are the new checks' effect on the demo cache.

Support review: regenerate the sentence for the same claim statement (event IDs differ between bundles) and show the text before/after. This does NOT re-measure support validity: no human reviewed the new texts.
